notes.title: Motorbike Shop Simulator 2025 – Dev Log #1 | Game Is in Development, Stay Tuned!
notes.content:
[p]We're actively developing [b]Motorbike Shop Simulator 2025[/b]! The game is currently in testing, and we're hard at work creating new mechanics, polishing systems, and adding fresh motorcycle models.
Please be patient as we shape the experience – your support means everything to us. 🚧🏍️[/p][p]🔧 Features in progress:
• New bike models
• Shop upgrades
• Deeper repair & customization systems
• UI improvements
• Gameplay optimizations[/p][p]Stay tuned for future updates, and don’t forget to wishlist the game! 💥[/p][p]#MotorbikeSimulator #IndieDev #DevLog[/p]
